thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: multi-gpu collective failures observed in tp4 pipeline jobs on prod-shard-17. Alerts: NCCL_COMM_TIMEOUT and CUDA Xid 79. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall-sre at 4317778888
mira: seeing consistent hangs in the allreduce step, job id job-0x9c4f. Containers keep restarting. GPU logs show Xid 79 followed by communicator abort
rafael: confirmed. nvcrash suggests nvlink hiccup then cuda driver reinit. Affected node: node-west-17b. Multiple containers (tp4 replicas) hit OOM in cuBLAS after retry loops
oncall-sre: I'm on it. moving node-west-17b to cordon/drain to stop new allocations. starting live mitigation plan: 1) cordon, 2) reroute traffic from scheduler to spare nodes, 3) enable fallback model variant (shard-17->shard-17-fallback) with lower tensor size
samir: are we seeing customer-facing errors? cs-team, any reports?
customer-success: we have 2 customers with elevated error rates on their endpoints routed to this shard. No customer-visible 5xx yet, but increased latency/timeouts. Notified both (context + we're investigating).
mira: quick diagnostic snippets: `kubectl -n runtime logs job-0x9c4f -c tp-worker --since=5m` shows repeated: `NCCL WARN Call to ncclCommInitRank failed, unhandled cuda error: unknown` then `CUDA Error: launch failed (Xid 79)`
eng-runtime: pushing a runtime probe: `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,DRIVER --json` shows driver 525.85, gpu mem fragmentation high, but no persistent out-of-memory at host level. Suspect driver/firmware transient + NCCL ring congestion
rafael: also found in dmesg: `NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus` followed by `kernel: pcieport 0000:65:00.0: AER: Corrected error`
oncall-sre: mitigation step 1 done: node-west-17b cordoned and drain invoked (eviction in progress). moving live tp4 jobs to spare nodes: scheduler flag `--prefer-fallback=on` set to avoid same shard placements
mira: I'm patching the runtime to reduce NCCL collective size: set env NCCL_MAX_RINGS=1 NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 and reduce per-gpu batch to 64 to avoid KV cache jump. Will deploy as canary to 2 replicas
samir: can we do a quick rollback-friendly workaround: force jobs to use model-quantized-8bit variant which uses less memory and different kernel path? Might avoid cuBLAS OOMs
eng-runtime: yes, enabling model-8q fallback for affected routes now. issuing rollout: `redwoodctl rollout set job-0x9c4f --model=redwood-13b-8q --canary=2`
incident-bot: automatic escalation check: 2 customers affected, error rate delta +18% over baseline. SLA risk flagged. Escalation to infra lead if not resolved in 30m
rafael: after cordon+drain, node shows GPU resets but no further Xid79s in last 90s. Pre-eviction logs still show NCCL timeouts due to half nodes in ring. Expect some retries to finish then restore
mira: canaries for runtime env changes show reduced NCCL errors on two replicas. pushing config to more replicas but holding at 25% until we confirm stability
oncall-sre: coordinating with scheduler to avoid placing two replicas of same pipeline on the same physical node (affinity tweak). command: `schedulerctl set-affinity job-0x9c4f --spread=host`
samir: Customer update draft: "We are investigating GPU collective failures causing intermittent timeouts. We have rerouted workloads and applied a fallback model variant; taking steps to prevent reoccurrence. Will update in 30m." Please review @customer-success
customer-success: looks good. will send now and include link to postmortem once available.
eng-runtime: temporary mitigation checklist: 1) cordon node-west-17b (done) 2) reroute affected shards -> fallback pool (done) 3) apply NCCL env tweaks to reduce ring usage (canary running) 4) enable 8-bit model fallback (canary running) 5) monitor token-level latencies and error rates (active)
mira: logs after env tweak on canary: `NCCL INFO topology: rank0->rank1 latency 12us` `NCCL WARN reduced rings from 4 to 1` errors dropped from ~12/min to ~1/min
oncall-sre: keep me posted. if errors spike again, we'll escalate to hardware team for node-level investigation and possible GPU replacement. Also opening ticket with cloud provider for PCIe AER events
rafael: open question: is this correlated with a recent kernel/driver push last night? driver version matches rollout schedule. checking CI deploys now
mira: temporary workaround ready to roll full: set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL and NCCL_IB_PCI_RELAXED_ORDERING=1 to reduce nvlink pressure. Will wait for oncall signoff
oncall-sre: signoff to roll to 100% after 10 more minutes of stable canary. currently 7m stable
incident-bot: note added to timeline: cordon/drain + fallback model + NCCL env tweaks at 4317779200
samir: customer-success, prepare a follow-up message at 30m with status and expected ETA for full mitigation (we aim for 60m resolution)
customer-success: acknowledged. sending update in ~15m with current state
mira: final note before wider rollout: also patched scheduler backoff to avoid aggressive retries which were exacerbating memory pressure. `scheduler-config.backoff=linear-30s`
oncall-sre: rolling to 100% NCCL env tweak now. monitoring closely
mira: 10m after full roll: error rate down to baseline, Xid79s stopped, no new GPU falls detected on drained node. Marking incident mitigated for customer impact. we'll keep node-west-17b cordoned for further forensics
eng-runtime: postmortem action items (capture now): collect nvdec / pcie AER logs, check firmware versions on node-west-17b, run repro with synthetic tp4 load, add scheduler placement guard to prevent multiple pipeline replicas on same host, add automated fallback to 8q model on NCCL timeouts, improve alerting thresholds to detect rising NCCL warnings earlier
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. will convert to postmortem thread and assign owners.
rafael: thanks all. great coordinated run. :thumbsup:
